$comment: Published tokens that are DELIBERATELY not bound into any framework surface (Bootstrap variable, Tailwind namespace, shadcn slot). Checked by scripts/audit-bridges.mjs, which fails when a published token is neither bound nor listed here — and when an entry goes stale (token removed, or bound after all). Every entry needs a reason and an owner. Tokens listed here are still published: they reach every consumer as var(--ucsd-*).

exceptions.reason: The icon-to-label gap inside a button. Bootstrap's .btn is inline-block with no gap concept (making it flex would change layout for every consumer), and Tailwind/shadcn size that gap with per-component utilities. Reachable as var(--ucsd-button-gap) for custom buttons.
